hangzhou-18.bio: Temple built around the tomb of Song general Yue Fei, a symbol of Chinese patriotism, on West Lake's north shore.
hangzhou-18.ticket_note: No official site found in search (only ticket platforms); not guessed.
hangzhou-18.notes: Adult 25 CNY from Qunar/Ctrip snippets (2022 era); may have changed. Visit duration is an estimate.

hangzhou-37.bio: Amusement park on the Xianghu lake shore in Xiaoshan, with rides and a neighbouring water park.
hangzhou-37.ticket_note: No official site found; hzparadise.com is an unrelated hosting company. Likely WeChat only.
hangzhou-37.notes: Price range from aggregators (128 from 2022 group-buy, 168 Trip.com, 190 China Daily 2022); weak, unverified. Water park is a separate ticket. Visit duration is an estimate.

jiaxing-2.bio: Pavilion on a small island in Nanhu lake, Jiaxing, reached by boat and set among gardens.
jiaxing-2.notes: Nanhu scenic area listed as free on Ctrip; boat (about 20 CNY) is transport and not counted. Whether the island pavilion itself charges is unverified. Bio claims (island, boat, gardens) come from search summaries of Ctrip/Qunar only.

ningbo-14.bio: Art museum on Renmin Road near Ningbo's Old Bund, hosting changing exhibitions of painting and contemporary art.
ningbo-14.ticket_note: Official site not found (nbmoa.com/.cn did not load); likely WeChat only.
ningbo-14.notes: UNVERIFIED: free entry and whether reservation is needed not confirmed by any source read; Ctrip page title mentions visit reservation. Address from Ctrip only. Exhibition content in bio unverified, check before use.

quzhou-5.bio: Glass-floored cliff walkway and gorge scenery in Quzhou's Qujiang district, with a zip line across the valley.
quzhou-5.notes: Adult 65 CNY on Zhejiang provincial tourism page (2019) and Qunar/Ctrip; glass walkway 20 and zip line 45 are extras. Visit duration is an estimate.

wenzhou-museum.bio: City museum on Shifu Road in Lucheng, with history, painting, calligraphy and pottery galleries, free to enter.
wenzhou-museum.notes: Site loaded, title 温州博物馆; states free admission Tue-Sun, ID required, optional reservation via WeChat, so no needs. Visit duration is an estimate.
